verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is indirect. Community comments refer to named regions such as us-east-1 and advise against running workloads there, which implies users can pick a region for their resources. No first-party documentation in the pack describes region selection, data residency controls or residency guarantees. Missing for 10: first-party docs on choosing a region per service or resource, data-residency and sovereignty commitments, controls to restrict data to specific regions, and independent hands-on confirmation of residency enforcement.
